# ToolTile

Quick-launch tiles: white card, radius-8, depth-1, a chamfered black icon plate and a mono module ID.

`PhantomPortals.ToolTile` · Command Center

## Use

```jsx
<PhantomPortals.ToolTile icon={…} title="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="PhantomPortals.ToolTile" icon="{{…}}" title="…"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Quick-launch tile. `current` marks the last-used tile with the crimson edge — one per grid.
